preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element a_i in the sequence a is between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for a_i in a if a_i == return_value[1][a_i-1]) == n - return_value[0]
postconditions.description: The number of elements in the modified sequence that do not need to be changed is n minus the minimum number of changes.

postconditions.expression: any(a_i == return_value[1][a_i-1] for a_i in range(1, n+1) if a_i == return_value[1][a_i-1])
postconditions.description: Each element in the modified sequence is valid according to the problem's definition of a valid sequence.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for a_i in return_value[1] if a_i == return_value[1][a_i-1]) == 1
postconditions.description: There is exactly one root in the modified sequence, which is the only vertex that is its own parent.
